name: Hafizabad

queries.query: Hafizabad Pakistan official cadastral map land records parcel GIS Punjab
queries.result: Found official Hafizabad district GIS/revenue pages, the Municipal Committee Hafizabad services-map index and a 2023-24 city base-map PDF with a parcel-boundary legend, Punjab PULSE cadastral-map material listing Hafizabad, and the Punjab Land Records cadastral-map interface. The public ArcGIS REST routes in the viewer configuration were token-gated in anonymous requests.

queries.result: Search results identified the official Punjab Land Records village-wise cadastral-map interface, Punjab PULSE/PLRA cadastral material listing Hafizabad, and Hafizabad district GIS/revenue pages. No anonymous safe Hafizabad parcel polygon response was exposed; the bounded REST routes returned Token Required.

officialSources.observation: Official Municipal Committee Hafizabad services-map index lists the Updated Maps 2023-24 set and Base Map_Hafizabad City.

Official rendered city base map dated April 2024, map version 1.5, includes a Parcel Boundary legend and municipal boundaries. It is not an exposed vector parcel API and carries a source-data disclaimer.
Official district page describes the Hafizabad GIS Cell and links Admin Boundaries (Patwar Circle), Health, and Revenue Estates maps.
Official district administration page assigns Revenue Administration maintenance and updating of periodical revenue/land records and oversight of registrations and related records.
Official/public Punjab PULSE viewer lists Hafizabad under Cadastral Maps and exposes parcel-related layers with an indicative-property-lines disclaimer.
Official Punjab Land Records cadastral-map interface is village-wise and requests district, tehsil, village, and year selection; no Hafizabad geometry was retained.

requests.outcome: Viewer HTML loaded. Current JavaScript configuration identified the public ArcGIS host, token endpoint, Punjab cadastral MapServer, and Hafizabad sublayer id 10. No token was requested or used.
ArcGIS error body code 499 Token Required; no service schema returned.
Hafizabad sublayer metadata route returned ArcGIS error body code 499 Token Required; no schema or CRS returned.
Bounded anonymous feature query returned ArcGIS error body code 499 Token Required; no ID or geometry returned.
Viewer-configured administrative MapServer metadata route returned ArcGIS error body code 499 Token Required; not a parcel response.
Viewer-configured GPC parcel service metadata route returned ArcGIS error body code 499 Token Required; no schema or geometry returned.
Direct curl attempt timed out after 20 seconds; browser-indexed first-party page evidence was separately available.

registryBasis: Official Municipal Committee Hafizabad material provides a city base map with an explicit parcel-boundary legend, and the official district administration identifies Revenue Administration land-record custody. This establishes local/public cadastral-map context, not legal title coverage or complete citywide vector coverage.

PULSE advertises Hafizabad cadastral material, but anonymous ArcGIS REST inspection was token-gated; no polygon IDs, schema, CRS, or citywide completeness were verified. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or account fields were requested or retained.
